why: The three small outside shapes turn into one big frame of the same shape, and the middle shape turns upside down and changes colour (black becomes white, white becomes black). So the white trapezoid becomes a black upside-down trapezoid inside a square: option 2. Option 3 is black but not upside down, and option 4 is not flipped at all.
trick: Check three things separately: what the outside shapes become, whether the middle shape flips, and whether its colour swaps.
note: Option 1 (white upside-down trapezoid inside a black square) also fits if you copy the black frame of the example instead of the colour swap. The book key says B (option 2).
